metadata.title: Preliminary Numerical Study of Gray-Cat Metastable Interfaces, Weak C Readout, and Strong D Observation Selection in a Closed Phase System
metadata.description: This preliminary numerical study models white-cat and black-cat alternatives as internal A/B allocation amplitudes in a closed complex phase system. It distinguishes a gray-cat eigen phase, a gray-cat metastable phase, natural selection, and large oscillation regimes. It then tests weak C readout windows and strong D observation selection while comparing against no-D controls. The study shows that weak readout can preserve and read a metastable gray allocation, while stronger observation can select a white or black allocation; gray eigen states remain gray even under strong observation.

title: Preliminary Numerical Study of Gray-Cat Metastable Interfaces, Weak C Readout, and Strong D Observation Selection in a Closed Phase System
